title: 第二十三章 怎么开价呢第二十四章 另外的价钱
content_zh:
第二十三章
严助理把陈言送回了家，临别之前陈言告诉他：“方总的事情我需要好好想想，算一算。
你们且等一等，若是有眉目了，我会跟你联系。”
严助理千恩万谢的离开。
陈言关上门后，走到客厅里，从怀里摸出那两个A4纸包摊开放在茶几上，陷入了沉思。
一张纸上是自己带走的那根檀香，路上已经压断成了两截。
一张纸上，是一小撮香灰。
陈言心里开始思索一个问题了。
这笔钱……
我赚还是不赚呢？
问题，就在这个檀香上。
陈言在秘籍册子的鉴物篇里看过一些基本的鉴定法子。
尤其是一些画符施法的基本材料的鉴别，已经牢记在心里了。
这檀香，香线呈黄色，看着就是那种市面上最常见的檀香。
但陈言的元气感应，能隐约的嗅到一丝若有若无的怨气！
掰开一截檀香仔细揉搓，揉搓成渣，又捏了捏香灰，两边对比了一番。
“掺入一丁点骨粉？”
鉴物篇里写过这种法子：把带着怨气的生物，死后的骨头碾成粉末，然后……这玩意儿，其实可以用来释放怨气的。
不过这个法子有些恶毒，不是正路，所以鉴物篇里只是提及如何辨别，具体的制作过程没有记载。
这种玩意儿，叫“怨骨粉”

东西有厉害的，也有不厉害的。
书上记载的，最恶毒的那种怨骨粉，乃是用足月前的死婴的身躯，拆出骨来研磨成粉——死婴原本可以成人，却功亏一篑，故而所含怨气最盛，做成的怨骨粉，也最为恶毒，效力强大。
轻则家宅不宁，病灾横祸不绝，最终破家人灭。
不过这种东西，一是难得，而是做法邪毒，炼制也极为困难，非是那种走邪路走得深的邪修才会做。
而普通的就容易得了。
用某种动物的骨头研磨替代。
而这种替代死婴的动物骨粉，到底是什么，却是寻常人一般想不到的。
——猪骨。
猪这种生物，世俗人家常食的家畜。
但很少有人知道，其实猪是一种智商颇高的动物。
都说狗通人性，狗是人类的朋友，忠诚的伙伴。
其实猪这种动物的智商，是比狗还高的。
在芸芸众生诸多哺乳动物里，猪都算是高智商种类了。
这玩意儿其实比狗更通人性的。
有不俗的智商，也粗通灵性，自然就会有一定的情感波动。
用猪来制作【怨骨粉】，做法就要容易的多了。
一来是这种家畜材料易得。
制作起来难度也少。
只要用特殊的手段，将一只猪屠宰后，再拨皮取肉，只留骨架，然后研磨炼制。
content_en:
Chapter 23
Assistant Yan sent Chen Yan home, and before leaving, Chen Yan told him: "I need to think carefully about Mr. Fang's matter and do the math.
Please wait a moment. If I have any clues, I will contact you. "
Assistant Yan left with a lot of gratitude.
After Chen Yan closed the door, he walked to the living room, took out the two A4 paper bags from his arms, spread them out on the coffee table, and fell into deep thought.
On a piece of paper was the sandalwood stick that he had taken away, which had been crushed into two pieces on the road.
On a piece of paper is a small handful of incense ash.
Chen Yan began to think about a question in his mind.
This money...
Do I make money or not?
The problem lies in this sandalwood.
Chen Yan had seen some basic identification methods in the artifact identification chapter of the secret booklet.
In particular, the identification of some basic materials for drawing talismans and casting spells has been kept in mind.
This sandalwood has yellow threads and looks like the most common sandalwood on the market.
But Chen Yan's sense of vitality could vaguely smell a hint of resentment!
I broke off a piece of sandalwood and rubbed it carefully until it was reduced to dregs. Then I pinched the ashes and compared the two sides.
"Incorporate a little bit of bone meal?"
This method was written in the article on appraisal: grind the bones of the dead creatures with resentment into powder, and then... this thing can actually be used to release resentment.
However, this method is a bit vicious and not the right way, so the article on identification only mentions how to identify it, and the specific production process is not recorded.
This kind of thing is called "Grudge Bone Powder"
There are some great things and some not so great.
According to the book, the most vicious kind of resentment bone powder is made from the bodies of pre-term dead babies, taking out the bones and grinding them into powder. The dead babies could have become adults, but failed, so they contain the most resentment, and the resentment bone powder made is also the most vicious and powerful.
At first, the family will be restless, and the disease will continue, and eventually the family will be destroyed.
However, this kind of thing is, first of all, rare, and the method is evil, and the refining is also extremely difficult. Only the kind of evil cultivators who have gone down the evil path will do it.
The ordinary ones are easy to get.
Replaced by grinding the bones of some animal.
But what exactly this kind of animal bone meal is used to replace dead babies is something that ordinary people would never think of.
——Pork bones.
Pigs are animals commonly eaten by ordinary people.
But few people know that pigs are actually very intelligent animals.
It is said that dogs understand human nature, and dogs are human friends and loyal partners.
In fact, pigs are animals with a higher IQ than dogs.
Among all mammals, pigs are considered to be highly intelligent species.
This thing is actually more humane than a dog.
If you have a good IQ and are proficient in spirituality, you will naturally have certain emotional fluctuations.
It is much easier to make [Begone Meal] with pigs.
First, this kind of livestock material is easy to obtain.
It is also less difficult to make.
Just use special methods to slaughter a pig, remove the skin and remove the meat, leaving only the skeleton, and then grind and refine it.
